verdict.rationale: Raygun documents an error-status workflow for triaging the error inbox. It supports marking error groups 'Resolved', bulk status changes, and ignore conditions by time period (effectively a snooze), by occurrence count, or by rule. Nothing documents assigning an owner, and nothing shows a resolved issue automatically reopening on regression; deployment tracking only mentions identifying regressions. Missing for 10: assign-owner capability, documented auto-reopen of resolved issues on regression, independent corroboration.
